name: prose-matches-read-grant
body:
The prose statement of what an agent may read must not exceed what its permission frontmatter grants. The read-guard denies read/glob/grep on graph-state paths while `"*": allow` keeps every other path readable; the prose must describe exactly that — graph-state paths are unreachable to the file tools, ordinary paths are readable — so a reader of the prose can never form an expectation the guard will deny. This is the alignment the defect broke (the prose claimed "any file"; the grant denies the graph-state files).

Acceptance: for each of the four agents, every read/glob/grep capability the prose claims is permitted by the frontmatter (no graph-state path is claimed readable); and the prose names the sanctioned alternative (the apg tools) rather than only the prohibition.
